reviewer.id: Fable 5.1 full twenty-lesson read and exact arbitration

approvalBasis: All 11 exact old/new corrections replayed and the entire result equals final independently reviewed sources.

readThrough.checks: All 40 turns read in Korean against the P1 spec staging: L1-3 -는데 background only, L4-6 -(으)ㄹ 때/-고 나서, L7-8 -다가, L9-10 two-sentence chaining with 그때/결국; no recognition-only form leaks into learner turns. Every first reply 6-12 eojeol, second reply 5-9, chunks join byte-exact, recall before+answer+after exact, speech tokens are whole lexical eojeol, trophies bare and matching allocation, captions quote only the opening in both bases, no delayed complication in title/situation/sceneCaption/visualNotes, all four turns 해요체, no gendered address, humble/honorific direction correct, form cues match the actual stem vowel (젖었는데/많았는데/나왔는데/마셨는데/봤는데). German/English bases read as speech; -는데 never rendered as weil.
readThrough.remainingConcerns: Adverb-order alternatives in build (e.g. 집에서 혼자 쉬다가 in L7, 토요일에 갑자기 산에 갔는데 in L1) remain possible; the build cue shows the base sentence and chunk glosses so the authored order is recoverable. L1 turn-3 sentence-initial 그래서 after 그다음에는 어떻게 했어요? is acceptable but not the most idiomatic (옷이 다 젖어서 would be). L10 계속 비가 왔는데 is a background -는데 with causal flavor; kept per trap rule since the base uses und. Trophy uniqueness against A1/A2 trusted to the gate.

readThrough.checks: Staging verified: L1-3 -(으)ㄴ/는 것 같아요 + -지만, L4-6 -기는 한데/-기는 하지만, L7-8 -아/어도, L9-10 -(으)ㄴ/는데도 + 그래도/역시; 느린데도/맛있는데도/긴데도/가벼운데도 all correctly formed and explained in the L9 rule. Reconstructions, recall spans, speech tokens, bare trophy anchors, captions, register and gender policy all pass my read. Cloze choice blanks are disambiguated by the turn's own base (20분쯤, 대화가, 천천히, 따뜻해요, 한산해요, 두 시에는, 휴대폰으로, 다른 데로, 깊이가); connector blanks 그래도 unique against 그러면/왜냐하면/따라서. German 'der des ersten Teils zu ähnlich' in L6 is correct.
readThrough.remainingConcerns: L1 아마 괜찮은 것 같아요 is heard in speech though 아마 pairs more idiomatically with -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요; left as licensed present-adjective hedge. 가봤어요 (L5 opening) and 가보니 (L9 opening) use the permitted attached 보조용언 spelling while L9 P1 and L5 turn 3 use the spaced form; both are standard, flag for a later consistency pass since changing the opening would also require caption edits. L10 concession link (book length vs liking humorous essays) is loose but matches the allocated beat.
